components.name: BaseField
components.desc: The reactive core every field type wraps. It owns the label, the value cell, required, locked and applies-when rules, the error and the hint. Field types only change the input and how the value is parsed and shown.
props: applies_when; hides and clears when false

components.name: TextField
components.desc: Single line text with a length limit.

components.name: LongTextField
components.desc: Multi-line text that grows with content.

components.name: IntegerField
components.desc: Whole numbers with optional minimum and maximum.

components.name: DecimalField
components.desc: Exact decimal with a fixed scale. Never a float; values travel as strings.

components.name: CurrencyField
components.desc: Exact money amount with two decimals. The currency code sits in a box before the input: fixed, from a field of the record, from a linked record or from an app setting.

components.name: PercentField
components.desc: Decimal from 0 to 100 with a % box after the input.

components.name: DateField
components.desc: Calendar date shown as DD-MM-YYYY, stored as an ISO date. A calendar opens from the input, with month and year views and Today; typing still works.

components.name: DateTimeField
components.desc: Date and time in the user's timezone, stored in UTC. The calendar has hour and minute steppers and Now.

components.name: TimeField
components.desc: Time of day without a date or timezone. Hour and minute steppers, common times and Now.

components.name: DurationField
components.desc: A length of time typed as 1h 30m, stored in seconds. Hour and minute steppers and common lengths.

components.name: BooleanField
components.desc: A switch for true or false. Wraps the Switch element.

components.name: SelectField
components.desc: One choice from a declared list. A list opens with the current choice ticked, a search box for long lists and Clear when the field is optional.

components.name: LinkField
components.desc: Picks a record of another model. Shows the record mark and title, and can filter its options by a rule.

components.name: EmailField
components.desc: Text checked for an address shape, with a copy action.

components.name: URLField
components.desc: Absolute http or https address.

components.name: PhoneField
components.desc: Phone number, normalized when it starts with a country code.

components.name: TagsField
components.desc: A short list of labels. Type and press Enter to add.

components.name: StateField
components.desc: Shows the current state. It never edits directly; the value changes only through moves.

components.name: SequenceField
components.desc: The document number. Read only, empty until the state that assigns it.

components.name: ComputedField
components.desc: A read-only value calculated from a rule. Hovering the hint shows the rule.

components.name: InlineValue
components.desc: Shows a field as plain text and turns into its field type on click. Enter saves, Esc cancels. Used wherever a record is read more than edited.
props: How the value reads at rest

components.name: SearchInput
components.desc: Text input with a search icon. Filters as you type and keeps the cursor in place.

components.name: Checkbox
components.desc: Square check for selection and task completion.

components.name: Switch
components.desc: On and off toggle. BooleanField and the layout control use it.

components.name: SegmentedControl
components.desc: Two to four mutually exclusive options shown together.

components.name: QuickAddInput
components.desc: A borderless input at the top of a list that creates an item on Enter.

components.name: Button
components.desc: The one button. Variants set meaning, sizes set density, an icon is optional.
props: primary, default, ghost, success, danger, soft danger

components.name: IconButton
components.desc: Square button with only an icon. Always carries a tooltip and an accessible label.

components.name: MenuButton
components.desc: A button that opens a menu of related actions.

components.name: MoveButton
components.desc: Runs a state move. When its guard fails it stays visible, dims and explains why on hover or click.

components.name: LinkButton
components.desc: Text link for secondary navigation inside panels.

components.name: AddChip
components.desc: Dashed chip that adds an item to a small set.

components.name: FloatingButton
components.desc: Round-ended button fixed to a screen corner. Shows a count when something is changed.

components.name: AppTab
components.desc: App icon in the app bar. The active one becomes a tab that opens into the sidebar.

components.name: NavItem
components.desc: Sidebar link with a tinted icon, label and optional count or badge.

components.name: Tab
components.desc: One tab in a Tabs bar, with an optional count.

components.name: Icon
components.desc: Line icon at 12, 14, 16 or 18 pixels. Takes the text colour or one of the tints.

components.name: IconTile
components.desc: Icon on a soft tinted square. Marks a page, a timeline entry or a card type.

components.name: Avatar
components.desc: Initials on a tinted circle for people. Four sizes.

components.name: AvatarFilter
components.desc: Overlapping avatars that filter a list by owner. Selected ones ring, others dim.

components.name: RecordMark
components.desc: First letter of a company on a rounded square. Square for companies, round avatars for people.

components.name: StatusPill
components.desc: Dot and label on a tint. One colour per state, taken from the State field.

components.name: Chip
components.desc: Small neutral label for tags, counts and flags.

components.name: CountBadge
components.desc: Count beside a label. Filled for unread, plain for totals.

components.name: Key
components.desc: Keyboard key hint.

components.name: Tooltip
components.desc: Dark label with a pointer, shown at once on hover and kept until the pointer leaves. Points down when above, up when below.

components.name: ProgressBar
components.desc: Thin bar for a share of a whole, with an optional number.

components.name: ScoreBars
components.desc: Four rising bars and a number. Colour moves from grey to amber to green with the score.

components.name: ScoreRing
components.desc: Circular gauge with the value in the middle.

components.name: Sparkline
components.desc: Small trend line with an area and a marked last point.

components.name: StageBar
components.desc: One bar split by share, with a colour per segment.

components.name: PlaceholderToken
components.desc: Shows where data goes in a layout preview.

components.name: Divider
components.desc: Thin vertical or horizontal rule between groups.

components.name: Stat
components.desc: Label, value and a short note. The unit of the summary strip.

components.name: SummaryStrip
components.desc: Four stats in one bordered row. Values come from the model's measures.

components.name: KpiTile
components.desc: Headline number with a trend against last period and a sparkline.

components.name: KeyValueList
components.desc: Two-column label and value list. Values are InlineValues when editable.

components.name: MiniCard
components.desc: Compact bordered row for a related record: mark, title, subtitle and up to two quick actions.

components.name: TaskRow
components.desc: Checkbox, title, due and the linked record. Overdue turns the due date red.

components.name: TimelineItem
components.desc: One journal entry: icon by kind, sentence, time and an optional body.

components.name: ChangeDiff
components.desc: Field, old value struck through, new value. One line per changed field.

components.name: MessageCard
components.desc: Bordered body for notes, calls and emails. Emails show a subject line.

components.name: EmptyState
components.desc: Tinted icon, a short heading, what to do next and an optional button.

components.name: StateBanner
components.desc: Full-width note under a header about the record's state, with optional actions.

components.name: InfoNote
components.desc: Quiet explanation above a block that behaves differently from the rest.

components.name: FilterChip
components.desc: An active filter with a remove button.

components.name: Toast
components.desc: Short confirmation at the bottom of the screen. Undo when the change can be reversed.

components.name: DataTable
components.desc: List table with a sticky header, pinned first columns, resizable columns saved per user, sorting and row selection.

components.name: BoardCard
components.desc: Draggable record card for boards: tags, title, linked record, value, date and owner.

components.name: FeedItem
components.desc: Compact activity line with a link to the record, for feeds across records.

components.name: ListRow
components.desc: Mark, title and subtitle on the left, value and date on the right.

components.name: BarChart
components.desc: Vertical bars with values on top and labels below. Current period full colour, past ones lighter.

components.name: FileRow
components.desc: File type tile, name, size, who and when, and a download action.

components.name: NotificationItem
components.desc: Icon, sentence and time. Tinted background until read.

components.name: Scorecard
components.desc: Score ring beside three labelled bars.

components.name: ChannelRow
components.desc: Contact channel with a preferred flag and a copy action.

components.name: AppShell
components.desc: The frame of every screen: sidebar with app bar on the left, top bar and one scrolling view on the right. Collapses the sidebar to icons; becomes a drawer on phones.

components.name: WorkspaceSwitcher
components.desc: Logo, workspace name and switch arrows. First row of the sidebar.

components.name: AppBar
components.desc: Row of AppTabs on white. The active app opens into the grey sidebar below with soft corners.

components.name: SidebarNav
components.desc: Grouped NavItems with small uppercase group labels. Scrolls on its own.

components.name: TopBar
components.desc: Sidebar toggle, breadcrumbs, search, notifications and the New menu.

components.name: Breadcrumbs
components.desc: Where you are, with links back up.

components.name: PageHeader
components.desc: Page icon, title, optional count and the page actions on the right.

components.name: Tabs
components.desc: Row of Tabs with an underline in the record accent. Scrolls sideways on phones.

components.name: Toolbar
components.desc: Search, filters and a summary in one wrapping row above a list.

components.name: Panel
components.desc: Bordered card with a header row and a body. The standard container on dashboards.

components.name: DocFrame
components.desc: The record layout: main column on the left, side panel on the right (or left). Side panel drops below on narrow screens.

components.name: SideBlock
components.desc: Titled block inside the side panel, with an optional header action.

components.name: Drawer
components.desc: Panel that slides in from the right over the view. For quick looks without leaving the page.

components.name: Modal
components.desc: Centred dialog with a header, body and footer. Esc and the scrim close it.

components.name: Popover
components.desc: Floating menu anchored to its button. Repositions near screen edges.

components.name: BulkBar
components.desc: Dark bar that rises from the bottom when rows are selected.

components.name: FloatingPanel
components.desc: Panel that opens above a FloatingButton and closes on outside click or Esc.

components.name: StickyBar
components.desc: Bar that sticks to the top of the view while the page scrolls.

components.name: DocHeader
components.desc: Record mark, record type, title, key facts and the main actions. Moves and actions come from the model.

components.name: StatusFlow
components.desc: The states of the State field as connected steps. Done steps tint, the current one fills, terminal states turn green or red.

components.name: LockBanner
components.desc: The record's lifecycle under the header: draft, locked with void and revise, or void with the reason.

components.name: ActivityComposer
components.desc: One box for a note, email, call log or task. Cmd Enter saves to the journal.

components.name: Journal
components.desc: Append-only history grouped by day: notes, messages, field changes, moves, postings and payments.

components.name: ChildTable
components.desc: Lines of a record. Pinned row and first column, resizable and reorderable columns saved per user, Tab and Enter editing, inline row expand, focus view and live totals. Locks with the record.

components.name: FormSection
components.desc: Titled group of fields in two columns. Long text spans both.

components.name: PostingsTable
components.desc: Rows the record wrote to other models, with reversals and a balance check. Read only.

components.name: Board
components.desc: Columns by state with counts, totals and drag to move.

components.name: ListView
components.desc: Page header, saved views, toolbar and DataTable, with a board switch when the model has a State.

components.name: CommandPalette
components.desc: Search across records, pages and actions, with recent searches and a customizable quick access grid.

components.name: QuickAccess
components.desc: Grid of tiles for modules, reports and documents. Documents carry a plus or list badge.

components.name: LayoutControl
components.desc: Floating control on records to show or hide blocks, set density and side panel position. On the layout page it edits the template.

components.name: CreateForm
components.desc: Dialog with the fields a new record needs, validated before it closes.

components.name: ActionDialog
components.desc: Small dialog that collects an action's inputs before it runs.

components.name: RecordPeek
components.desc: Drawer with a record's header, quick actions and details, plus a button to open the full record.

components.name: NotificationsPanel
components.desc: Popover list of recent notifications with mark all read and a link to the inbox.

components.name: SidePanel
components.desc: Stack of side blocks: next step, key fields, highlight card, people, related records, tags and record info. Each can be turned off.
props: From the template and user layout
